payload.rebuttal: fixed: The test staged README.md with a long sentence, then rewrote the working copy back to exactly the HEAD content. Since `--tree` lists only files `git diff HEAD` reports changed, a working copy identical to HEAD drops the file out of that diff entirely, so `read()` was never called and the mutant to `read()` had nothing to act on. I changed the working copy to a different, hit-free text instead of the original HEAD content, so the file stays in the diff and the test now depends on `read()` returning the working-tree content rather than the staged blob. Verified this now fails against the named mutant.
